recipe.label: Gel-Lit

traits.texture: clean photographic surfaces, luminous edge gradients and broad colored shadows
traits.composition: keep the reference silhouette and framing while separating cool and warm light across major planes
traits.lighting: cyan key light from one side and warm coral rim light from the other with controlled deep shadows

review_checks: Cool and warm light directions remain distinct
The subject stays readable through the colored lighting
Highlights and shadows describe surface planes
limitations: A lighting aesthetic; it does not specify a calibrated light rig, product color accuracy or a physical miniature.
Palette, fine geometry and cross-image consistency require visual review; generation is not deterministic.
